{{Quote|Welcome, or maybe sympathies, given that this is a backwater town on the galaxy's backwater-iest world. But even here, one person can make a difference.|Bren Kingal|<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Mos Taike''' was a small [[City/Legends|city]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==History==
[[File:MosTaikeMeatlumps.jpg|200px|thumb|A small chapter of Meatlumps just outside of Mos Taike]]
It was located just outside [[Mos Entha/Legends|Mos Entha]], between the [[Xelric Draw/Legends|Xelric Draw]] and the [[Northern Dune Sea/Legends|Northern Dune Sea]].<ref name="ITWOEI" />

The [[Mayor/Legends|mayor]] of the small settlement was [[Gramm Rile]], an older individual who cared a great deal about [[Gender/Legends|his]] citizens.<ref name="SWG" /> [[Lorne Prestar]] acted as the [[Chief of Security/Legends|Chief of Security]] for the city. It was also the former home of [[Ackli]].<ref name="I74">{{InsiderCite|74|Pearls in the Sand}}</ref> Additionally, the [[Xenobiologist/Legends|xenobiologist]] [[Dusque Mistflier]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] scientist [[Tendau Nandon]] once investigated a [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon]] graveyard located near the city.<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the city could be described as a small backwater town on a small backwater world. Still, it was home to a number of notable venues, such as the [[Third Sun Cantina]]. This establishment, managed by a [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] named [[D'Mayna Stallaphalat|Stella]], doubled as a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] and a medical center. The city had a number of other facilities, such as a garage for vehicle reparations, but it lacked any kind of shuttleport for incoming travelers.<ref name="SWG" />

By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a gang of [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] technology-hating [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorists]] known as the [[Meatlumps]] established a small chapter on the outskirts of Mos Taike.<ref name="SWG:MtM2">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Muddle the Meatlumps|Corellia}}</ref> The [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Cale Herron]] also resided in Mos Taike.<ref name="SWG:FCH">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Find Cale Herron|Tatooine}}</ref> Around the same time, a [[Eyan McDermitt's pirate gang|gang]] of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] led by [[Eyan McDermitt]] was based in the city.<ref name="SWG:CE">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Spy|Corporate Espionage|Tatooine}}</ref>

Sometime following [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Mos Taike was vulnerable to repeated [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] attacks. The mayor pleaded with both the Galactic Empire and [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] for protection, but to no avail. Fortunately for the mayor, with the help of a devoted [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]], the city gathered enough citizens to repel a massive Tusken raid.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mos Taike was one of many cities on Tatooine that players of the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' could visit, prior to the game's closure on [[December 15]], 2011. However, unlike the other cities on Tatooine, Mos Taike was the only one which lacked a shuttleport for easy transport to and from the town.<ref name="SWG" />
